add_message_headers(UNICODE arp_msg.mc)

# arp.exe is all Rust (arp-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/arp-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# arp.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/arp-rust/src/arp/arp.rs)
add_cargo_module(arp arp-cargo arp.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE arp-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS arp_msg psdk)
